_comment: Copy this file to data/resources.json to add your own study destinations alongside the built-in ones. Placeholders in url are substituted and URL-encoded. Term links may use {strongs} {number} {lemma} {translit} {twot}. Verse links may use {book} {bookSlug} {osis} {chapter} {verse} {ref} {bibleHub} {blb} {sefaria}. Only http(s) URLs are accepted; malformed entries are ignored.
